title: Wiemer form fields
description: Plain form parts: a 15px label with a blue required star over a white, hairline-bordered 50px field (or a tall message box) with 6px corners, a consent checkbox with small text and an underlined link, and a full-width blue submit bar that presses in slightly on hover.
notes: the blue is the theme's highlight colour
name: wiemer-field

props.name: name
props.description: the field's name in the submitted form

props.name: type
props.description: input type (text, email, tel…); ignored when multiline

props.name: placeholder
props.description: hint text inside the empty field

props.name: required
props.description: required fields get a blue star

props.name: multiline
props.description: a tall message box instead of a one-line field
